name: ChatPDF
tagline: ChatPDF lets you upload any PDF and ask questions about its content in plain language — the AI reads, understands, and answers from the document without requiring you to search through pages manually. It's used for research papers, legal contracts, financial reports, and textbooks. Students and knowledge workers use it to extract insights from dense documents in minutes rather than hours.
